findings.title: Uploaded file does not become the preview after opening an older file link
findings.detail: Browser UAT reproduces old URL selection overriding the newly uploaded file. Explicitly select the new file as a temporary workaround.
findings.acceptance: Upload from an existing file link and show the new original/extraction while keeping the old file and all exact source IDs intact.

findings.title: Damaged encrypted original returns generic HTTP 500
findings.detail: Synthetic corruption fails closed and exposes no source bytes, but misses the controlled integrity/recovery response. BAUT-08 remains a strict known failure.
findings.acceptance: Missing, unauthentic ciphertext and authenticated wrong content each produce controlled errors; restored original bytes and review history remain exact.

findings.title: Scanner is unavailable in the deployed stack
findings.detail: Allowlisted health/readiness reports the running scanner unhealthy/unavailable. No signatures were refreshed and no upload bypass was used.
findings.acceptance: Verify admitted current offline signatures, scanner/extractor readiness, clean intake and malware rejection without touching case originals.

findings.title: Local provider relay is stopped
findings.detail: Read-only posture sees the relay stopped/unhealthy. Fixture completions do not qualify the actual tenant, model or five-job operation.
findings.acceptance: Restore the approved local route and verify authenticated identity, no cloud fallback, bounded grounded completion and concurrent workload separately.

findings.title: Installed backend is not byte-identical to reviewed main
findings.detail: 129 of 130 tracked backend Python files match d9ff2b16; context_packing.py differs. No installed code was overwritten. Image, dependencies and frontend identity are not attested.
findings.acceptance: Reconcile the intended context-packing change, qualify an exact candidate, and record installed source/image/dependency identities.

findings.title: Item-level release prerequisites omit declared phase gates
findings.detail: The audited R08-05 transitive checklist graph omits required intake, target-host, graph coverage, evidence, adverse-search, correction/depth, freshness, calculations and playbook gates. Milestone semantics must stay separate from code completion. The audit PR prepares the eleven missing dependencies without altering item or milestone completion states.
findings.acceptance: Reconcile all declared mandatory phase gates with the checklist closure, explicitly keeping optional BYOK and deferred features separate.

findings.title: Engineering focus needs to return to product acceptance
findings.detail: 89 merged PRs are linked to partial F00-06. Ten completed R03 navigation increments do not supply the first reviewed corpus. Stop automatic depth growth and use a bounded intake-to-reviewed-export acceptance packet. The audit PR selects F00-04 defects followed by F00-06 target operation as the next engineering sequence; the pending owner review remains separate.
findings.acceptance: Select observed user-workflow defects and current pilot readiness as engineering priorities; retain the owner and corpus reviews as independent gates.

findings.title: 194 merged PRs lack an explicit checklist link
findings.detail: This is a traceability gap, not a claim that the work is absent. The audit maps all 93 items to scoped code/test references. The current CI row also needs the applicable thirteen-job reserve profile.
findings.acceptance: Backfill evidence-based links and current criteria without fabricating acceptance or rewriting past progress snapshots.

findings.title: Private owner review and public-corpus approval remain pending
findings.detail: The selected private analysis v3 still awaits the owner. Public source rights, independent legal/ontology review and exact historical applicability require their own real evidence; subagents do not grant those approvals.
findings.acceptance: Record actual review decisions against exact source and analysis versions, with accountable eligibility and disclosed coverage.

findings.title: End-to-end legal, load, recovery and lawyer usefulness gates are unqualified
findings.detail: No present authenticated production UAT session was available. These selected synthetic tests do not establish representative extraction, five-job load, independent recovery, held-out legal correctness, screen-reader/cross-browser acceptance or preparation-time reduction.
findings.acceptance: Execute the reviewed release-specific workload, recovery, human and held-out evaluations; retain unknown denominators and record failures.
